passages.text: Dasylirion longissimum, common name the Mexican grass tree, is a species of flowering plant native to the Chihuahuan Desert and other xeric habitats in Northeastern Mexico.

Description
Evergreen trunk-forming shrub, slow and moderate growing to {{convert|4|to|6|ft}} tall and wide, and can be up to {{convert|12|ft|m}} tall by {{convert|8|ft|m}} in diameter. The long bladed leaves are up to {{convert|4|ft|m}} long by {{convert|0.24|in|mm|0}} across.
